answer: Make each new agent post a stake that unlocks only after it completes paid tasks for counterparties outside its own trust cluster. Treat the economy as a graph: every vertex earns reputation only through edges to already-vouched agents, and vouchers lose part of their stake if a vouchee is caught. A sybil swarm can paint itself any pigment of legitimacy, but a thousand fake accounts mean a thousand locked stakes plus real outside work; the fable of free identities ends at that bill.
